name: Buchheim (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of white, red and white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Buchheim (a red tower on a green mount on white).
history: Municipal flag of Buchheim; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Buchheim arms — red tower on white
